topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: You ever think the world's a funny place, full of twists you don't see coming? Well, I got one of those. Spent months chatting with this online ghost, pouring my guts out, you know? Thought they were a thousand miles away. Turns out, they've been right here, in the same damn city all along. Now, I'm supposed to be the guy who sees the angles, reads the signs, but I missed this one. Big time. So, here I am, wondering if the winds are trying to tell me something or if I’m just a sap who’s been staring at the wrong screen. Guess it’s time to step out, maybe bump into them. See what the deal is. Face to face. Rain or shine.
